reviews.title: Data Missing
reviews.text: Since IOS 27, half of September and all of August data is missing, will not retrieve or sync data from the Health app. Prior to this, was a great app, been using for a couple of years with no issues.

reviews.title: What happened!
reviews.text: On the last few days the GPS has crapped out on my app. When finished with a walk the GPS screen would show me the exact route on the streets I walked and tell me how many steps, time, distance, and speed. Now it shows zeros for that info and instead of exact route on individual streets, it shows a direct point to point route missing a lot of the streets. It still shows the total of steps on the first screen but not on the GPS screen. If they don’t get this fixed don’t buy this app, not worth it!
